endorsements.name: Gregory Allegoet
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-11560
endorsements.description: The Team Members Showcase WordPress plugin before 3.5.0 does not sanitize and escape a parameter before outputting it back in the page, leading to reflected cross-site scripting, which could be used against high-privilege users such as admins.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.
